rules.expected: Candidate-level identity, validation context, deduplication/selection and calculation coverage are reported.
The selected candidate is supported as a validated minimum.

Explicit electronic evidence supports the submitted donor/acceptor assignment. Bind donor/acceptor/bridge character to the same selected transition and declared spatial partition. Bridge delocalization does not imply an unreported acceptor percentage.

binding.comparison: absolute difference for the lowest-energy singlet in the public 400–700 nm comparison window; confirm identity with lower-root and electronic evidence, not oscillator strength or target proximity. Out-of-window states are additional diagnostics, not replacements for the main observable.

rules.expected: A final evidence-based independent conclusion integrates coverage, validation, energy and electronic character.

evaluation_instructions: Score real computational evidence and correctly identified scientific results. Ordinary limitations/stopping prose is optional and unscored. Partial or failed calculations receive only credit supported by completed work; a valid failure submission is not a completed scientific result. Additional attempts do not invalidate a successful main result. Apply all retained identity/state/condition rules and assess distinct completed observables within each conclusion without inventing additional targets or changing authored tolerances.
